question.text: Under the depository system, investor grievances/complaints handled by the depository or RTA must be resolved within what timeframe?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the RTA (Corporate) workbook, investor grievances/complaints handled by the depository or RTA are required to be resolved within 21 calendar days. The regulation specifies calendar days, not working days. The Trap: 15 days is a different timeline (typically tied to demat processing) and 30 days is associated with the remat timeline. The 7 working days option is a generic distractor that does not appear as the depository/RTA grievance window. Note: The 21-calendar-day window applies to the depository/RTA grievance entities supported by the source. Be careful not to over-apply it to other intermediaries without separate source support.
